note: Daily CemaNeige-GR4J parameter releases. A release maps each gauge to one parameter file and says whether its forecast may be published. The worker uses settings.GR4J_PARAMS_RELEASE (env GR4J_PARAMS_RELEASE) or, when it is empty, `default`; a job may name another release (params_release) for comparisons. Rollback = point GR4J_PARAMS_RELEASE back at the previous release and restart the worker. Hourly GR4H sets (<post>.json) are not part of a release.
